business_summary: China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd. engages in the retail and distribution of pharmaceutical products in China and internationally. The company offers new and special drugs and medications for chronic diseases. It also provides traditional Chinese medicine, Western medicine, rehabilitation therapy, and various medical-related resources, as well as chemical drugs, OTC drugs, and health products. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Corp., Ltd. China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China. China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Sinopharm Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd.는 중국 및 해외에서 의약품의 소매 및 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 만성 질환을 위한 새로운 특수 의약품과 약품을 제공합니다. 또한, 한의학, 서양의학, 재활치료 등 다양한 의료 관련 자료를 제공하고 있으며, 화학의약품, 일반의약품, 건강식품도 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Corp., Ltd.로 알려졌습니다. China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd.는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다. China National Accord Medicines Corporation Ltd.는 Sinopharm Group Co., Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
